problem_1.name: Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS)
problem_1.description: Monitor changes in ocular structure and visual function against each eye's personal pre-flight baseline. Findings request review; this app does not diagnose SANS. New visual loss, visual field defects or central distortion require medical assessment without waiting for a repeat measurement.
problem_1.hrp_risk: Risk of Spaceflight Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS)
problem_1.source: Criteria: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 2. HRP risk: https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/esdmd/hhp/risk-of-spaceflight-associated-neuro-ocular-syndrome/ . Repeat timing [P]: 10 minutes is an estimated prototype re-acquisition interval selected under Edu's authorization to use estimates, not a NASA measurement or validated SANS recommendation. Analogy: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0221466 , Methods, OCT measurements, reports nine consecutive scans within less than 10 minutes in healthy eyes; it does NOT prescribe a 10-minute wait or establish equivalence to peripapillary TRT, refraction or visual-acuity confirmation. This is a minimum demo countdown, not a follow-up schedule or a reason to delay medical assessment. Level/state definitions are documented in #43. Reviewed, inactive protocol content is in config/protocols/sans.json and config/protocols/muscle_atrophy.json. Activation and legacy-id migration remain blocked by #31/#38; baseline-relative conditions and non-evaluable handling await Ansel approval and #41/#48 implementation. Existing detection rules remain placeholders, not completed medical rules.

problem_2.name: Muscle atrophy
problem_2.description: Monitor muscle strength, size, power, endurance, tone and stiffness against a comparable personal pre-flight baseline. Statistical changes request review and do not diagnose atrophy. Sudden weakness or failure of a critical task requires medical assessment without waiting for maximal tests or repeat measurements.
problem_2.hrp_risk: Risk of Reduced Physical Performance Capabilities Due to Reduced Muscle Size, Strength, and Endurance (Muscle Risk)
problem_2.source: Criteria: guia_breve_umbrales_atrofia_SANS (1).pdf (2026-11-14), p. 1 and p. 2 clinical-priority note. HRP risk: https://www.nasa.gov/directorates/esdmd/hhp/muscle-risk/ . Repeat timing [P]: 2 minutes is an estimated prototype minimum based on rest between isometric strength trials: https://stacks.cdc.gov/view/cdc/9182/cdc_9182_DS1.pdf , printed p. 14, Rest Period Length. Rest must be extended if fatigue remains. This is not a validated atrophy confirmation interval for all indicators, a treatment, or a NASA-measured recovery time; extrapolation to a per-problem demo countdown is a prototype choice authorized by Edu. Do not perform maximal tests with pain or delay medical assessment for sudden weakness/critical-task failure. Level/state definitions are documented in #43. Reviewed, inactive protocol content is in config/protocols/sans.json and config/protocols/muscle_atrophy.json. Activation and legacy-id migration remain blocked by #31/#38; baseline-relative conditions and non-evaluable handling await Ansel approval and #41/#48 implementation. Existing detection rules remain placeholders, not completed medical rules.
